When a page has a trailing slash (like `/docs/php/tooling/`), the key is `/docs/php/tooling/`. But the link `/docs/php/tooling#composer-bin-plugin` parses to the pathname `/docs/php/tooling` (without trailing slash).

In `isAnchorBrokenLink`, when we have a link like `/docs/php/tooling#composer-bin-plugin`:
- `pathname` = `/docs/php/tooling` (no trailing slash)
- It looks up `collectedLinks.get('/docs/php/tooling')` or `collectedLinks.get(decodeURI('/docs/php/tooling'))` = `/docs/php/tooling`
- But the collectedLinks map is keyed with `/docs/php/tooling/` (with trailing slash) because the docs route has the trailing slash.

So `targetPage` is `undefined`, and it's reported as a broken anchor.
